original_loss_note: The per-arm train_log.jsonl and run_manifest.json were on the pod only and were not included in the teardown bundle. They are gone; this file is derived from the driver console log and is not a substitute for them.

exact.seconds: printed from the already-rounded stored value
exact.val_blocks: printed as part of the eval dict repr
exact.val_ce: printed as part of the eval dict repr
exact.val_ppl: printed as part of the eval dict repr
exact.val_kd: printed as part of the eval dict repr

truncated.loss: console printed %.4f; the stream stored 6 decimals
truncated.ce: console printed %.4f; the stream stored 6 decimals
truncated.kd: console printed %.4f; the stream stored 6 decimals
truncated.lr: console printed %.2e; the stream stored the full float

derived_from_config.tokens_seen: step * batch.blocks_per_step * block_len, recomputed here from the run config rather than read from the log
derived_from_config.run_name: taken from the config the driver invoked

bounded_only.time: no per-line timestamp was printed. Each arm's events lie between its driver command line and its TRAIN_DONE marker; those two bounds are recorded per arm and no per-event timestamp is invented

unrecoverable.run_start: the event and its freeze report were never printed
unrecoverable.dataset_loaded: tokenizer hash and token mix were never printed

config._purpose: Experiment 6b (objective x data-scale interaction): the P2-CE-heavy objective (ce 1.0 / kd 0.25, kd_scope all) trained at the strictly nested 2.96M rung. Composed mechanically by scripts/training/build_e6b_configs.py from e4_p2_r1600k_sa (objective and everything else) and e1_r2960k_sa_pca (rung, schedule, cadences). Trains from the Stage 1 PCA init, NOT continued from P2-1.60M. The only intended difference from e1_r2960k_sa_pca is the CE/KD weighting.

time_bounds.note: per-event timestamps were not printed; every event in this arm falls between these two bounds

wall_clock.note: measured between the driver command line and the TRAIN_DONE marker; larger than the printed per-step timing because it includes evals and checkpoints
